gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, of the 1 kWh-class candidates, only the EcoFlow DELTA 3 Plus is documented by its maker as sending a PC a shutdown signal over USB-C (HID, via EcoFlow PowerManager or NUT); the non-Plus DELTA 3, Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2 and BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 pages list no such link; and the twolven GitHub project reports that on September 2026 DELTA 3 Plus firmware Windows' built-in HID UPS battery driver rejects the device (Code 10), so automatic shutdown on Windows needs NUT and a WinUSB driver swap.
standout_why: ChatGPT's chat lists no search results and no cited pages, so there was no rival page to compare against. Its answer covers switchover time, wattage and runtime but never says whether a power station can tell the PC to shut down before the battery runs out, or which models can. A real UPS such as the CyberPower CP1500PFCLCD or APC BR1500MS2 does this as standard. ChatGPT also missed that the C1000 Gen 2's North American page rates its grid pass-through (1,800 W) below its 2,000 W inverter rating.
decides: This supports picking the DELTA 3 Plus over the DELTA 3 for a gaming PC that may be left unattended. Both have the same inverter, but only the Plus documents a USB-C HID shutdown signal. The page should warn that on Windows this currently means installing NUT rather than relying on the built-in battery icon. For the other picks (C1000 Gen 2, Elite 300, Elite 200 V2, Jackery 1000 v2), the PC keeps running until the battery is empty and then loses power with no warning. For the C1000 Gen 2, keep the protected load under 1,800 W, the pass-through rating on Anker's 120 V page. The 2,000 W figure is the inverter rating.

findings.label: PC/NAS shutdown signal (maker)
findings.value: Yes: 'sends a signal before the battery is fully depleted to prompt the server to save data and then shut down'; 'supports NAS servers and HID communication functions'; switchover under 10 ms; desktops named as a use
findings.note: Footnote: install the EcoFlow PowerManager app on the computer, then NUT Server on the NAS, and turn on HID support. The same footnote still reads 'The formal launch version will come later in December', which is stale wording. The page covers only the Plus and does not say whether the non-Plus DELTA 3 has the link. Our current page says it has none, but I did not re-source that today.

findings.label: Windows native HID UPS compatibility on current firmware
findings.value: Fails: Windows shows 'USB Input Device' Code 10 (0xC00000B9). Workaround: NUT 2.8.5 usbhid-ups (EcoFlow subdriver) after swapping Interface 0 to WinUSB in Zadig; shuts down at a set charge level (default 15%)
findings.note: Unofficial project by GitHub user twolven, tested on Windows 11 24H2/25H2 with DELTA 3 Plus firmware from September 2026. The author says the 2024 firmware enumerated as a plain HID device, that the current composite firmware advertises a 376-byte report descriptor but returns nothing for it, and that Linux and NUT tolerate this. Same USB ID (3746:FFFF) across DELTA 3 Plus, RIVER 3 Plus, DELTA 3 Max Plus and Ultra Plus. Needs a USB-C data cable; EcoFlow's manual, as summarized by search, says one is not included.

findings.label: Auto-shutdown link and output (maker)
findings.value: USB-B port to PC or NAS; Power Manager 'notifies you when RIVER 3 Plus is running low, prompting devices to save data and initiates an automatic shutdown'; under 10 ms switchover; 600 W AC
findings.note: This is EcoFlow's most explicit auto-shutdown claim, but 600 W is below a gaming PC's draw (ChatGPT's own table puts high-end systems at 450–700 W), so it suits a router or NAS, not the gaming PC.

findings.label: Pass-through (bypass) limit vs inverter, 120 V model
findings.value: AC output 2,000 W max; AC (Bypass) 1,800 W max; AC input 120 V, 12 A max; UPS 10 ms
findings.note: The US product URL returned 404, so this is the 120 V/60 Hz Canadian page. The page mentions no PC communication or USB shutdown signal and gives no guidance on which devices the UPS suits. A search excerpt of Anker's manual says SurgePad does not work in bypass mode; I did not open the manual (the file was over 10 MB).

findings.label: Bypass vs rated output (maker)
findings.value: UPS 10 ms or less with 980 W bypass power; 600 W rated
findings.source_title: BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 + 100W Solar (BLUETTI US store)
findings.note: Read with storecheck search on bluettipower.com. A PC drawing 600–980 W runs fine on grid pass-through, then overloads the 600 W inverter the moment the grid drops. The same trap applies to any station whose bypass rating is above its inverter rating.

findings.label: US price; UPS terms
findings.value: $899.00; 2,600 W continuous AC. The product page's FAQ 'Does Elite 200 V2 have a UPS function?' has no answer text in the page as fetched, and the page lists no PC link or bypass limit
findings.source_title: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 Portable Power Station | 2,600W 2,080Wh
findings.note: Price from storecheck product (Shopify variant, compare_at $899, in stock). Page text from WebFetch.
